# The WAF-exclude scope test (scope_hosts), run by both sides:
#   the in-path WAF, configs/lua/cfm_waf_excl.lua scope_takes / skip_for
#   (scripts/tests/cfm_waf_excl_scope_test.lua), and the Go matcher,
#   internal/webdetector/exclude_store.go compiledScopeMatcher /
#   MatchWAFRules (TestWAFExcludeScope_EdgeParity).
# Columns: SCOPE HOST EXPECT. SCOPE is the entry's scope_hosts, comma
# separated, "-" = none (every host). HOST is the request host. EXPECT 1 = an
# exclude with that scope applies on HOST.
#
# No scope: every host.
-                      shop.gr           1
-                      other.example     1
# A literal scope host is that host and its www. alias (cPanel lists a
# domain without it): no other subdomain, no substring, no reverse alias.
shop.gr                shop.gr           1
shop.gr                www.shop.gr       1
shop.gr                WWW.SHOP.GR       1
shop.gr                shop.shop.gr      0
shop.gr                www.www.shop.gr   0
shop.gr                wwwshop.gr        0
www.shop.gr            shop.gr           0
www.shop.gr            www.shop.gr       1
shop.gr                myshop.gr         0
shop.gr                shop.gr.evil.com  0
shop.gr                other.example     0
SHOP.GR                shop.gr           1
shop.gr                SHOP.GR           1
shop.gr,shop.gr        shop.gr           1
a.gr,b.gr              b.gr              1
a.gr,b.gr              c.gr              0
xn--shop-9ta.gr        xn--shop-9ta.gr   1
# Globs are anchored; a host has no "/", so * crosses dots.
*.shop.gr              www.shop.gr       1
*.shop.gr              a.b.shop.gr       1
*.shop.gr              shop.gr           0
*.shop.gr              evilshop.gr       0
*.SHOP.GR              www.shop.gr       1
shop.gr,*.shop.gr      shop.gr           1
shop.gr,*.shop.gr      www.shop.gr       1
*                      anything.example  1
shop.g?                shop.gr           1
shop.g?                shop.gre          0
# Globs get no www. alias (Go matchExact: literal scope hosts only).
shop.g?                www.shop.gr       0
a+*.gr                 a+x.gr            1
a+*.gr                 aax.gr            0
a%*.gr                 a%x.gr            1
a\.*                   a.gr              1
a\.*                   axgr              0
# Bracket classes (the characters a host name holds).
shop[0-9].gr           shop1.gr          1
shop[0-9].gr           shopa.gr          0
shop[!0-9].gr          shopa.gr          1
shop[!0-9].gr          shop1.gr          0
shop[^ab].gr           shopc.gr          1
shop[^ab].gr           shopa.gr          0
[ab]x.gr               ax.gr             1
[ab]x.gr               cx.gr             0
[a-c.]x.gr             .x.gr             1
# An unusable glob takes no host, and a scope made only of them takes none
# (it must never read as "no scope").
shop[a.gr              shop.gr           0
shop[a.gr              shopa.gr          0
shop*\                 shop.gr           0
shop[a.gr,b.gr         b.gr              1
shop[a.gr,b.gr         shop.gr           0
